name: Roasted Chestnuts
summary: Glossy dark-brown nuts, domed on one side and flat on the other, a dull scar across the base and a short point at the tip, a few split open to golden flesh, spilling out of a small kraft paper bag lying on its side on the table. One is peeled.
notes: Shown as it ships in KL Rush, compressed for the web (meshopt geometry and, where it has textures, KTX2). A download copy will be exported from source once the model is cleared.
